Momentum Engineering, Inc. Openings

ME00692-Software Engineer 1

ME00692-Software Engineer 1

Momentum Engineering, Inc. fosters an employee-centric culture. Our strength lies in our people. With a high percentage of employees holding advanced degrees in engineering, computer science, and related disciplines, we bring deep technical expertise to every mission. Our team includes professionals with security clearances and full-scope polygraphs, ensuring trusted, secure support for the most sensitive national security initiatives. Additionally, our workforce is equipped with industry-leading certifications, demonstrating a commitment to continuous learning and excellence. Most importantly, our exceptional employee retention rate reflects a culture of professional growth, mission focus, and dedication—ensuring long-term stability and expertise for our customers’ critical needs.

Job Summary

Seeking a Software Engineer to support the development, enhancement, integration, testing, and sustainment of complex software systems within a mission-focused environment 
This role includes front-end development, cloud application deployment, workflow automation, and integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities into established systems and processes
The ideal candidate is a versatile software engineer with strong problem-solving skills, a solid foundation in software development principles, and experience working across modern web, cloud, automation, and DevOps technologies

Primary Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and enhance complex software systems based on documented requirements
Analyze user requirements to derive software design, functional, and performance requirements
Design and develop user-friendly graphical user interfaces and interactive dashboards
Build responsive and accessible web interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js
Develop software using Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and TypeScript
Design, deploy, and manage applications and supporting infrastructure in Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Work with AWS services including EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and RDS
Support Infrastructure as Code using technologies such as Terraform or CloudFormation
Integrate new functionality into existing applications and tools through technology transfer and system integration activities
Design, implement, and maintain automated workflows that improve operational efficiency
Develop Python scripts and use workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or AWS Step Functions
Integrate artificial intelligence and machine learning models into existing software systems and workflows
Monitor and optimize automated workflows and AI/ML model performance
Debug existing software, diagnose software problems, and implement corrective actions
Modify existing software to correct defects, adapt to new hardware or environments, improve performance, or add new functionality
Integrate existing software into new or modified systems and operating environments
Develop and optimize database and data repository interfaces and queries
Develop simple and complex data queries for existing or proposed databases and repositories
Design and implement algorithms to meet system functional and performance requirements
Review and test software components for compliance with design requirements and document test results
Assist with developing and executing unit, integration, and software component test procedures
Write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and testable code
Write, review, and maintain software and system documentation
Provide recommendations for improving software development processes, documentation standards, and engineering practices
Support system design activities, including hardware/software tradeoffs, software reuse, COTS/GOTS evaluation, and requirements allocation
Analyze system performance standards, data flows, data usage, work processes, and problem areas to develop effective software solutions
Design and modify software systems using analytical methods and models to evaluate design outcomes and performance
Support CI/CD pipelines, containerized environments using Docker, and cloud security best practices
Use tools such as Git and automated testing frameworks to support version control and software quality
Collaborate with developers, system engineers, users, and other cross-functional team members throughout the software development lifecycle
Work effectively both independently and as part of an Agile development team

Required Qualifications

Must have active Top Secret/SCI clearance with NSA Full Scope Polygraph
Experience developing, maintaining, testing, and integrating software systems
Experience with software requirements analysis, design, development, debugging, integration, and testing
Experience with Python and modern web development technologies
Experience with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
Proficiency with at least one modern JavaScript framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.js
Experience developing responsive web-based user interfaces
Working knowledge of AWS cloud services and cloud-based application deployment
Experience using Git and software testing frameworks
Experience working within Agile software development environments
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a technical team

Desired Qualifications

TypeScript development experience
Experience with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation
Experience with Airflow, AWS Step Functions, or similar workflow orchestration tools
Experience integrating AI/ML models into software applications
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines
Experience with Docker or other containerization technologies
Knowledge of cloud security best practices
Experience developing database interfaces and complex data queries
Experience with COTS/GOTS integration and software reuse strategies

Exempt hourly position.  11 paid holidays, minimum of 3 weeks PTO, company sponsored group medical plan, company paid dental, vision, life insurance, and STD/LTD plans.  Salary is dependent upon the candidate’s experience and qualifications.

The pay range for this role is:

110,000 - 155,000 USD per year (NBP)
